brief_md:
# Ship your greeting CLI

## What you'll ship

One bash script that prints a greeting and exits successfully.

## What you're proving

You can write a small script, run it, and read its exit status.

## Scope

- Print the greeting.
- Exit 0 on success.

## Rules

Build it yourself. Documentation is allowed.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] The script runs.
- [ ] The greeting appears.
- [ ] The exit code is 0.

rubric.name: Runs successfully
rubric.solid: The script executes with bash and exits 0.

rubric.name: Prints the greeting
rubric.solid: The expected greeting appears in stdout.

rubric.name: Handles failure
rubric.solid: A missing argument or failing command is reported.

rubric.name: Readable
rubric.solid: Names and comments make the script easy to follow.

artifact.title: A greeting CLI
artifact.deliverable: One bash script that prints a greeting and exits successfully.

files.capstone_test.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
out=$(bash greeting.sh Ada)
[ "$out" = "Hello, Ada!" ]
